raw_response:
This small barley plot near my home is where I grow grain for my family's injera and bread, so I take care of it myself. I can afford a little DAP and urea from the cooperative because barley responds well, but I cannot buy much — I will spread some manure from my cattle too since I have many animals on my larger land. I keep my own barley seed from last harvest like my neighbors do, and the rains in Oromia are usually enough so I do not irrigate this plot. My husband and older children help with ploughing and weeding, and at harvest I may call a few neighbors for a work-day.
